$schema: Content recovery source manifest. See CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md, 'Required manifests and validation'.

sourceRepositories.licenseNote: Per tmp/glitch-items/README.md: CC0 1.0 Universal, except the Glitch logo/trademark which are explicitly excluded (not relevant to the assets converted here).
Reference-only game logic data; not used as a runtime dependency (see CONTENT_RECOVERY_PLAN.md - must be translated, never executed as trusted server code). Not converted by this pass.

vectorRenderer.role: Rasterizes SWF vector shapes/timelines (DefineShape/DefineSprite) to per-frame PNG. Required because every inventoried source SWF in inhabitants/chicken and harvestable_resources/wood_tree is 100% vector art with zero embedded bitmap tags -- confirmed via tools/swf-extract-bitmaps.py, see 'bitmapExtractionAttempted' below.
vectorRenderer.reason: ~20MB Java application archive; not vendored to keep the repo small. A human/CI step must download and unzip this exact release (or a pinned equivalent) before re-running the pipeline. See tools/README-swf-pipeline.md.

frameLabelResolver.role: Parses the SWF tag stream directly (stdlib zlib/struct only) to compute REAL 1-based animation frame numbers for each named FrameLabel tag inside a chosen DefineSprite, by counting ShowFrame tags. This is more reliable than ffdec's -dumpSWF text output, whose per-line counters are nested-tag-list positions, not frame numbers.

sheetPacker.role: Packs a contiguous run of ffdec-exported per-frame PNGs into one horizontal sprite-sheet PNG matching the coUserver Spritesheet grid model (frameWidth x frameHeight x numFrames, single row). Fails if frames are missing or of inconsistent size.

bitmapExtractor.role: Diagnostic/fallback: extracts embedded raster tags (DefineBits*/DefineBitsLossless*) directly without rendering, for source SWFs that DO bake bitmaps rather than vectors. Run against both selected sources first; both reported zero bitmap tags (161 and 24 unextracted vector shape tags respectively), which is why ffdec rendering was required instead of a simpler direct-extract path.

assets.sourceFormat: SWF (version 9, zlib/CWS-compressed), 100% vector shapes (161 DefineShape tags, 21 DefineSprite symbols), no embedded bitmaps
assets.conversionMethod: ffdec -export sprite (rasterize) -> swf-frame-labels.py (resolve real frame numbers for each named state) -> build-sprite-sheet.py (pack each state's frame range into one PNG strip)

outputs.note: Original hardcoded coUserver value was numFrames=27; the resolved real frame-label range in the source SWF is 40 frames (388-427, next label 'pecking_once' at 428). Using the source-derived value.

deferredStates.reason: Present as a frame label in the source SWF (single frame) but not referenced by any state in coUserver's Chicken entity class. Not converted; left for a future pass if a gameplay use is identified.

assets.sourceFormat: SWF (version 9, zlib/CWS-compressed), vector shapes only (24 DefineShape tags across 4 growth-stage DefineSprite symbols), no embedded bitmaps
assets.conversionMethod: ffdec -export sprite (rasterize each of the 4 growth-variant DefineSprite symbols, 6 frames each) -> build-sprite-sheet.py (pack each variant's 6 frames into one PNG strip)
assets.validationNote: The converted frameWidth/frameHeight for each of the 4 growth-variant symbols matches, pixel-for-pixel, the 4 distinct crop rectangles previously hardcoded in coUserver/lib/entities/plants/trees/woodtree.dart against a single (now-dead) remote URL -- strong independent confirmation that this pipeline reproduces the original asset geometry exactly, not just a lookalike render. A pre-existing copy/paste bug where all 4 Spritesheet entries shared the literal stateName "maturity_1" was also fixed while rewiring the URLs.

assets.sourceFormat: SWF (version 9, zlib/CWS-compressed), vector shapes only (57 DefineShape + 19 DefineShape2 + 2 DefineShape4 tags, 1 DefineSprite), no embedded bitmaps
assets.conversionMethod: ffdec -export sprite (rasterize) -> swf-frame-labels.py (resolve real frame numbers for each named state) -> build-sprite-sheet.py (pack each state's frame range into one PNG strip)
assets.validationNote: All 7 resolved frame ranges match the previously hardcoded coUserver numFrames values exactly (24/53/48/60/65/10/24) -- strong independent confirmation the pipeline reproduces the original animation boundaries precisely for this asset.

assets.sourceFormat: SWF (version 9, zlib/CWS-compressed), vector shapes only (5 DefineShape3 tags on the main timeline, 1 unrelated DefineSprite), no embedded bitmaps
assets.conversionMethod: ffdec -export frame (rasterize the main timeline directly -- there is no separate named character symbol for this asset) -> build-sprite-sheet.py (pack the full frame run into one PNG strip)
assets.validationNote: The source SWF's main timeline actually has 6 frames, not the 5 implied by the previously hardcoded coUserver numFrames=5 (state name '5-4-3-2-1' suggests 5 depletion stages). All 6 real frames were kept rather than dropping one to match the old count; see the comment left in coUserver/lib/entities/plants/rocks/metalrock.dart. rock_metal_1 of the 3 sibling numbered variant folders was used arbitrarily as the representative source; the other two were not converted in this pass.

notConverted.note: Everything else under tmp/glitch-items (~5400 files across inhabitants, harvestable_resources, seeds, food, furniture, tools, etc.) remains unconverted pending further passes. See content/runtime-manifest.json 'deliberately deferred' rows and RECOVERY_TODO.md.
